_doc: Source clips for retarget.py (cq 012), KayKit Adventurers 1.0 (CC0). root: inplace = horizontal root motion stripped (a clip ends where it starts), in-place sway kept. strike: find the contact frame (the weapon tip's fastest frame inside strike_window, as a share of the clip). classes: the weapon classes the clip is checked with. holds: how the source holds each class (slot bone, the weapon node's rotation in it, and the source reference weapon's own tip/edge axes, Blender axes).

Running_A._note: no planted frame registers in this run (both feet leave the floor), so its ground speed is set to Running_B's measured one

1H_Melee_Attack_Chop._why_aim: round 2: its cut lands 34 to 54 degrees to the right of the body's forward (measured arc -74..-34); with the aim hold on, the drawn body turns 35 degrees so the blade meets the target (build 21 and the low tier are untouched)

UAL_Jog._why_speed: build 20 pass 2: measured in game (tools/anim/loco_measure.gd) after damp_legs halved the stride; the build measured the undamped clip (4.0 / 5.615 per hip), so the feet skated

UAL_Sprint._why_speed: build 20 pass 2: measured in game (tools/anim/loco_measure.gd) after damp_legs halved the stride; the build measured the undamped clip (4.0 / 5.615 per hip), so the feet skated

Whirl_Spin._why: cq 016: the spinning attack retargeted for robes: the legs and spine are damped relative to the hips (not the world), so the whole body turns with the hips instead of twisting against them; with the spin-aware secondary sim it passes the gate on Elvis, Crystal-Z and Hoof

Staff_Idle._why: cq 016: the staff hold: the source clip with the right forearm and hand turned so the staff stands orb-up (retarget.py staff_upright); the staff set only, so no other class changes; one-handed: the left hand on the upright shaft stretched Crystal-Z's left arm past the gate (0.75 %), so the left hand stays where the source keeps it, by the right

hammer._why: tilted 10 deg back about its own X: the diagonal slice's wind-up no longer passes the head through the shoulder (weapon_clipping.txt)

_doc_damp: damp: per character, bones that take only a share f of the source's rotation (long robes, skirts and baggy trousers stretch between the legs on wide stances; cq 060's rig weights)
_doc_alt: alt: in order, the clips tried when the set's clip stretches a character's mesh past the gate (cq 060's tear measure); none left: a loop keeps the character's own cq 060 clip, a one-shot the procedural pose
_doc_gate: gate_by_state: a looser gate for run: a walk sped past 2x skates visibly, a run's short stretch at speed does not show at the fight camera (measured per clip in tools/anim/reports)
_doc_ik: lhand_ik: on frames where the source's left hand is on its weapon (within d_off of the weapon's axis, fading over 12 cm), a two-bone IK puts the target's left hand on the held weapon, s metres along it from the grip (the grip of the given class)
_doc_body: body: the fight's procedural body motion (hop, spin, lunge) plays on top of the clip; body_alt: only when an alternate stands in (a WHIRL without a spin clip still spins)
_doc_autorig: autorig (9 Nov 2026): run = the UAL jog (ground speed 4.0 per metre of hip vs 2.3 for Running_A), sprint = the UAL sprint above the geometric mean of the run's and the sprint's ground speeds (combat_animator.update), so the hero's 4.6 m/s plays near 1x; stagger = KayKit Dodge_Backward for knockback shoves. A character whose jog or sprint tears past the run gate keeps the old run (alternates).
_doc_mocap: realism-20261111: sets_mocap overlays the classic sets per weapon set and state when the game's motion switch is "mocap" (config "motion", anim_library.gd); a state with no overlay or no pick under the gate keeps its classic clip. set_base: a set that exists only in the overlay (unarmed) takes the rest of its states from this classic set. Sources per clip are in clips.<name>.source; lib cmu = cmu2glb.py, lib m2m = m2m_merge.py. run and sprint both play the captured jog (one cycle, rate = body speed / its ground speed): the UAL sprint was retargeted with its leg swing halved and shuffles.
_doc_hybrid: hybrid_states[set][state] = mocap | classic | blend for the game's "hybrid" motion (the default with motion_realism). A state not listed plays its overlay clip. As judged in rounds 2 and 3: the sword's first and second cuts are captured (the second beat build 21 3 to 0 and the classic 6 to 0); the third cut is the classic chop turned onto the target by its aim_yaw_deg (captured lost to build 21 2 to 6); the two-handed heavy is classic; the sword idle is classic (it beat build 21 7 to 0 once a standing fighter stood still, and the captured idle 10 to 2); the victory is classic (Mesh2Motion's did not beat it: 1 to 1, 4 undecided).
_doc_readable: anim-readable (13 Nov 2026): sets_readable[set][state] = the readable body action each button plays (composed clips, R_*, tools/anim/compose.py), picked per character under the same tear gate (first of clip and alt; none passes = keep what the motion switches give). hero_poses[key] = a faction hero's own intro and victory. readable_default: on in every tier; the fight config "readable": false gives build 25's clips. Composed clips: "contact" is the frame that lands on the game's hit moment, "out" ends the game-length part, "tail" (frames) plays on past it while the fighter stands still.
